name: U_default
description: The default universal model: vm-00054's QNA (vm-00055: 34.7 +- 10.2 food, 3.5 +- 0.6 poison per 1k over eight seeds). Four separate transformers, one per quadrant of the view, each with its own patches and every pyramid summary; one body, the move by gain; position by age, acting on a key and value ring. The egocentric touch world with checker poison in 2x2 cells and circles that never overlap. A channel per value (vm-00066, the default since 2026-11-01, the owner): the body and the move have their own rows in the tables. Log summaries (band_win = 1, the default since 2026-11-02, the owner, vm-00073): a piece reads a summary only within 1 cell of itself at that level, sharp near and coarse far.
